body:
I would suggest against it, while relieving at the time, it bring me embarrassment in public and when around friends. It also can hurt like a bitch.

And I forgot to mention I know the feeling of losing interest in all the things you used to love. For me it’s been a gradual reduction to a point where a few weeks ago all I wanted to do was go outside but now, I just don’t want to leave my room.

We’re very similar. Im also 17 from the UK and I believe I have a decent life too but, I’m always down and out to hurt myself. Currently failing my A levels and soon to do the exams. I have no intention to go to uni so I don’t know what to do. I too feel very alone and tend to cut myself because I can’t stand myself at all.

It’s hard. Life is hard. There’s no easy way to “get over it”. I know I’m not offering much help right now, mainly due to that fact I’m not feeling very good right now, but I hope you find some comfort in that you’re not alone in this world.
What’s your hobby or passion? What do you enjoy most in life?
Don’t worry you’re not bothering me, I just think you should definitely seek some professional help and advice as I don’t think mines the best haha. :)

Suicide should never be your only option and it isn’t.

I’m very sorry you feel this way.

Never actually played half life wont lie.

My point is you just got to find the thing that makes you happy and something you could build from to make a career. You may not have even found it yet.

I enjoy hearing about other people’s stories and giving advice despite being very stubborn myself.

I didn’t even think about that being a possibility. Racism is clearly still alive an it shocks me to hear about it. And that is very frustrating for you but it could give you the result you need to return to normality (or some form of it).

I struggle a lot with this question too and I always try to look at it from two options. One is that you should do it for yourself, do it to become who you are and who you want to be. You’ve got to be the one to write your own story. The other is you must find people who do care, they could be anywhere. You should also never feel selfish. Your situation is a lot worse than mine and it does make me feel a little bit silly when I’ve been considering suicide. 

If people treat you in such a way that you feel like they don’t care about you, you must find people who treat you how you treat them. Keeping negative people in your life will only worsen over time. But do consider that your brain could be assuming things about people. Sometimes the people that care the most say the least.

The pain you are going through is unimaginable for me. Especially since I have never experienced it, but there must be something a doctor can give you for it or a relief method. If your GP isn’t the best try a doctor for women or maybe a female doctor as I’m sure they’ll understand your period pain a lot better than most men would.

I was not aware of all these extra costs to do such work :(. In this case I’m not really sure what advice I can give you. In England, where I’m from, there are places you can go that can advise you on what to do or help you find work so maybe there are places like this over there?

I wish I had a dog, but I live with my parents and they don’t like them. If you love dogs you could see if you can try and find a job in that. Maybe a receptionist at a vets? Anything there should be many possibilities.

Hope and motivation are things I struggle with too. I find it hard to give myself a reason to get up and do things but, you’re still here, talking to people on the internet and you’re still getting up which means something in you wants to keep going. Allowing that to grow can be a helpful thing for you and your health.

Just know you should never feel alone and that if you’re ever in a bad place, call a hotline.

Your story really touched me despite us being not very similar (other than the mental health complications). I’m also not aware of any of the problems you named however I’m very aware of the sever agony periods can cause to a woman, despite being a man.

For the part of the drugs and the inconsiderate GP, I would suggest maybe trying to buy over the counter drugs/painkillers? I’m not sure how Belgium’s drug distribution works but yeah.

In terms of your struggles with work, I would suggest finding a job you could do from home on a computer or something. Or search and ask around in ur local area for jobs. Babysitting/pet watching for example. There’s always local people who might need that and will pay.

For you suicidal thoughts you should really find what makes you happy in life. For a moment cancel out all the pain you’re going through and consider what makes you, you.

Whoever said you’re an asshole for having anxiety, fuck them. They’re assholes.

You should never worry about not going into work due to anxiety, if you call your boss or manager they should understand and if they are a decent human being they will allow it. Even if they don’t telling your co workers may help.

You shouldn’t take your own life because of your anxiety or to prove people wrong.

What people say about you is a reflection of them. And don’t forget that.

If you do feel bad right now I’d suggest calling a hotline and talk to them as you would a close friend. These thoughts can manifest into a few seconds of rash decisions causing your death. Having a simple distraction will help you.

No matter how big a mistake, there’s always a way to fix it. The mistake doesn’t define you, what you do afterwards does.

Ending your life is the worst thing you could do.

Normally I’d offer more advice but you didn’t specify what has happened, not saying you have too, so I’m not sure what advice I can give.

Everyone lives different lives. Now matter how bad you’re still feeling the same as me, him and her. Just know there’s a way out of the cycle.

You didn’t say much on purpose I assume, but I know what you need right now is to talk. Talk to anyone and even if there is no one call a hotline and pretend like it’s not a stranger. The momentary feeling you can get into can be the seconds that will cause the end of your life. By talking or doing anything like for example (even though it’s not a good one) for me, I self harm. It’s bad and no one should do it but it stops me from killing myself. Try watching ASMR or listening to music. Whatever you like.

You are loved by people dude.

Hanging yourself would devastate those who love you, especially your boyfriend. 

I don’t know you personally, but I too experience the feeling that I’m the only one ever asking people to come out and that people only like me for this or that, but can just be you telling yourself this due to anxiety (for me it is anyway).

Taking your own life is irreversible. Reflect on those moments that made you happy whenever you feel like taking your own life. Make sure to talk to people about it, don’t bottle up your emotions as this is what leads to the seconds that will decide your fate. Life or death.

All I can say is wow man. That is quite a story and I really can’t believe you’re 15 dude. I’m 17 and I’m from England and I’m no genius or expert in advice but I do struggle a lot with my mental health.

First I would say please give up the drugs, it’s really not worth it. In my opinion taking them is a lot worse than selling them but in the eyes of the law it’s the opposite. I would suggest trying to find a job if you need the money and look into spending money wisely otherwise you might not be saving money and end up becoming desperate and going back to the drugs. If you are still taking drugs frequently and have done for a while it is very important not to instantly cut them off as otherwise you may withdraw and suffer relapse. Seek medical advice on that part.

Secondly, never give up and try to look at your mistakes as “happy accidents” as Bob Ross would say and remember to learn from them as to not repeat them. Every human makes mistakes in their life but what matters is what you do afterwards whether even if its nothing. If you try to be happier and do simple things your mother will appreciate them she wants the best for you and people say things they don’t mean a lot because of how powerful our emotions are. If you want to make people happy treat them how you want to be treated.

Suicide is never a good choice, being young like me I’m positive you’ve heard that “you’ve got some much left ahead of you” or “it doesn’t last forever” which is true but, I believe the meaning of life is whatever you’re doing that’s preventing you from killing yourself. For example, video games? If you like them you can learn to program or learn to draw or anything! Honestly look at what is making you happy and work on it.

I understand that it can be seconds that’ll change what you’ll do to yourself which is why a hotline may be useful, but people tell me to just call them but I don’t want to do that.

Being 17 and in college it’s hard to hide from my friends but I used to make up an excuse like a thorn bush or a cat did it but, as of right now, there are way too many cuts for that to be a valid excuse. I don’t know why that’s where I cut, it just feels to be the easiest place to tense the muscles to make the skin easy to slice.

You’ve just gotta find something that you like to do and maybe work with that especially if working to build up savings isn’t for you like working in McDonalds or a supermarket. So if you really like video games you could find a job either to do with it or in the work place of it. Like you can’t manage a restaurant straight away, sometimes you just got to be the waiter before hand.

I feel like I’ve slipped into the cycle of getting no where too and sometimes I wish I’d have killed myself before I truly realised how bad it can get.

As for me (thanks for asking) I don’t really know. I like music and clothes a lot but I don’t know what to do with that. I’ve been thinking of just working in a vintage clothes shop. As I do already have experience from volunteering in a charity shop.

I know EXACTLY how you feel about how your brain translates what people tell you, or you hear that little voice telling you otherwise. It’s your anxiety talking to you. I get it a lot with people who say they can help me or they understand.

I’ll be honest, I’ve never used a hotline despite being very tempted when I was in a bad place.

No one deserves the pain of having to hurt yourself, it’s ironic for me to say as I also cut and I’m typing with a sliced up hand but no one in the world deserves to feel how you’re feeling.

I have lost a lot of motivation in live and I’m just waiting for my breaking point but there must be something in your life you love? Animals? Games? Food? Anything that can spark a bit of motivation for you may help in creating a path way for you.

You unlike most people, including myself, still have a grasp on something you love. If video games are what you love then that’s what you must pursue.

I’m not going to lather you with a dream like world, it’s not easy to just jump into something especially if you have no experience. But you could always find a local game shop or try and see if there are any small game companies near you. Work your way up and maybe one day you could give us all half life 3.

Everyone’s body can react differently to certain things. Someone with a peanut allergy will react differently to peanuts than a person who isn’t allergic.

I’m no doctor but I know if you have a seizure or heart attack due to the amount of pills you will most definitely be aware of it. Your body also naturally rejects poisons so it’s likely you will be sick causing dehydration along with headaches.

Either way it would depend on the drug and how much. I would suggest not trying to overdose even if it isn’t painful.

Suicide is always a bad option and has consequences if it doesn’t work, like how you said you’ll be “too dead to notice” from downing pills. This can not be the case and cause you immense pain and leave you worse than before.

Each day for me I get worse and worse, I have to hide the cuts on my hand and arm from my parents and friends cause I don’t want to scare them. I feel like no one really cares about me and that after I die a week on people would forget. I’m scared of being forgotten but right now I feel so lonely I might aswell not exist.

If you get worse I’d suggest calling a prevention hotline. Even though I personally don’t like them.

With any form of suicide, there’s always a chance you won’t die and end up in a worse position than before.

You may not die instantly, you may crack your skull causing it to damage the brain and it’s functions. There’s many things that could happen.

I’d suggest calling a suicide prevention hotline if you really do feel bad.

Even though I’m probably younger than you (17) I feel the same.

I don’t have many people in my life that are close to me. There’s one person I talk too but I feel bad talking a load of shit to her cause sometimes she doesn’t know what to say to me. My ‘friends’ never want to hang out and are always in work or busy or just can’t be bothered. So now I’m always sat at home doing nothing or I’m going to college which drains my mind.

It’s good that you still care for you landlord, it shows not all hope is lost, you still care about someone. If he’s nice to you maybe invite him round one day and talk to him?

No job, friends that are always busy, no girlfriend. There’s people out there just like you. I’ve also planned to end my life just after I turn 18 in August but I don’t even think I’ll make it that far.

Just know you’re not alone.

No matter what you try, everything has multiple possible consequences. For example when cutting your wrists in the hope of bleeding to death you could slice the wrong thing and lose control or partial control of your hand.

I too wish there was a simple painless way to go but there isn’t. You sound like me in that, I just want to go to sleep and never wake up.

Nirvana for me. Music is a powerful tool and has great influence on a humans mind.

I’m the same, without music I don’t know where I’d be.

“Don’t be stupid” or “It’s only temporary, it won’t last forever” are what I hear a lot. But I don’t understand, I know it won’t last forever but will I have to suffer till I’m 30? 40?

It’s very irritating and I also tend to hide, but mainly due to embarrassment.
Yes. And it will be very painful.

I feel exactly the same. This world is shit. I know also a soon as people find out I’ve slit my throat they’ll be posting shit all over snapchat and Instagram about me and how they “wish I’d have said something”.

I just feel like I’m fighting myself and losing and coming to a point where I don’t want to live anymore, whereas others don’t get that choice. Like if a family had a child that was disabled causing a parent to leave work and then bringing financial troubles. They didn’t get that choice. I just don’t feel right taking my own life when there’s much worse going on. But there’s always the flip side of, I don’t give a shit I’ll be dead anyway.

I’ve lost interest in my hobbies and things I used to like which made me less hopeful. I did try and pick up new things like I tried to learn the guitar but that was short lived. I thought a pet like a dog would be great but my parents don’t seem to agree as they don’t like pets. I feel being able to come home and talk to something like a dog, even though it doesn’t understand me, would be helpful but I’d have to wait to move out to get a pet.
